description:
02:24 How does this Eucharistic Congress fit into the prophecies of the last days?
14:52 I came across Matthew 10:23, where Jesus says, “You will not have gone through the cities of Israel before the Son of Man comes.” This verse has been a source of confusion—was He speaking literally? What does this mean in context? And how can I respond when someone says this was a mistranslation or error? Let’s explore the possible interpretations and what scholars and believers say about this intriguing passage.
